meta.title: Guides
meta.description: Where the task-oriented pages are: the four integration guides, and the capability pages behind them.

scope: The step-by-step guides of this site live under <link to="/integrations/">Integrations</link>: each one starts from an empty project and ends in a schedule you can build on. This page is the map to them, and to the pages that answer the questions a guide would raise.

points: <link to="/getting-started/usage/">Usage</link> — the shortest complete example, and what each prop in it is for.
<link to="/integrations/vite/">Vite</link>, <link to="/integrations/nextjs/">Next.js</link>, <link to="/integrations/react-router/">React Router</link> — the same schedule in three setups.
<link to="/integrations/ssr/">Server rendering</link> — what to pass so that two renders agree.
<link to="/demos/">Demos</link> — eight days of a schedule, each with its source.
<link to="/customization/">Customization</link> — how far you can go without forking anything.
